rule: Current measured sizes become the maximum allowed. Future changes must not grow a tracked artefact beyond its limit (plus tolerancePct). Lower limits as the refactor lands; raising one is a reviewed exception (see docs/SIZE_BUDGETS.md).

exceptions.reason: Reviewed exception for the world-class pre-sales advisory upgrades: power strategy in exported DOCX/HTML (+5 KB CSS, +4 KB JS), chain-blocker export gate (+1 KB JS), cross-product compatibility validation (+8 KB JS), regional SKU governance (+4 KB JS), network infrastructure assurance (+3 KB JS), power budget module (+2 KB JS), feedback-informed guidance (+5 KB JS), feedback consolidation panel (+6 KB JS), assurance blockers on Recommendations page (+3 KB JS), needs-site-survey flag (+2 KB CSS), best-efforts T&Cs page (+2 KB JS), and governed spec evidence (+1 KB JS). Growth is distributed across lazy-loaded page chunks and utility modules; the initial:js increase reflects the new assurance/power modules imported by the proposal wizard which is already lazy. Remaining weight is the target of the Phase 2/5/8 extraction programme (see docs/SIZE_BUDGETS.md).

Reviewed exception for the compare confidence-tier and evidence-trace feature work. The tier chip (with colour-blind-safe glyphs), verdict-lead banner treatment, projects-list tier badge and shared print styles added ~18 KB emitted CSS; the governed competitor-decision ledger (33 approved decisions, ~15 K lines) embedded in the competitor-registry chunk added ~54 KB JS and raised total JS ~86 KB; the verdict-tier helper, chip plumbing, approved-ledger promotion wiring and strong-direction coupling fix added ~15 KB to the Compare page; the evidence-trace default-expand fix and typed-SKU deep-link helper added ~0.9 KB to ProjectDetailPage. Growth was minimised by extracting the chip (CompareConfidenceTier.tsx) and decision queue (CompetitorDecisionReviewQueue.tsx); the remaining weight is the Phase 2/4/7/8 extraction programme's target (see docs/SIZE_BUDGETS.md).

Reviewed exception for the governed-data coverage campaign and compare-trust work. The four newly profiled WyreStorm products (SW-0X01-8K, SW-130-TX, APO-VX20-UC, NHD-610-TX) added ~13 KB of governed profile data bundled into the competitor-registry chunk via the governed product-data module; the chunk remains the Phase 5 extraction target (load a manufacturer data on demand) documented in docs/SIZE_BUDGETS.md.
